meta.note: The repo had no style code at this commit. Colors were sampled from the user's pixel-art reference of Nell (1.png). Bubble kinds, the opacity ladder and the timings come from the spec and the plan. Departure Mono comes from rektdeckard/departure-mono, which the user chose.

color.note: Plum Night. Everything is sampled from Nell's pixel sprite: hoodie plums, hair browns, skin creams and eye pinks. The user-blue, leaf-green and gold were added for the spec's states and tuned to sit in the same muted, warm range.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 1-art-pixel outline drawn around every panel, bubble, button and sprite. It is the sprite's own line color.

tokens.name: plum-900
tokens.usage: The deepest shade: the message-bar well, and hard drop-shadows under panels.

tokens.name: plum-800
tokens.usage: The bottom and right bevel of panels and buttons, and the pressed-button fill.

tokens.name: plum-700
tokens.usage: The default panel and bubble fill (Nell's hoodie). Text on it is cream or muted.

tokens.name: plum-600
tokens.usage: A raised panel or a hovered button, and the top-left bevel on plum-800 grounds.

tokens.name: plum-500
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels, and disabled control borders (the glasses-frame grey).

tokens.name: hair-700
tokens.usage: Wood-like brown for the desk and for neutral chips at rest. Taken from Nell's hair shadow.

tokens.name: hair-500
tokens.usage: The highlight on hair-700 surfaces.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Primary text and icon ink on every plum surface (8.9:1 on plum-700). It is Nell's skin highlight.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Text on user-blue and berry fills, where cream would be too warm or too low in contrast.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, mode badges, 'more in ⌘' hints (5.7:1 on plum-700).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: A soft warm tint for the done/happy beat and the listening glow.

tokens.name: pink-400
tokens.usage: The signature accent from Nell's eyes. Used for the 1-px highlight edge on top of panels, focus rings, the caret, and the selected mode chip.

tokens.name: pink-600
tokens.usage: Accent when pressed, and the shadow side of pink-400 bevels.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: The Deny button fill and error-bubble accents. Use snow text on it (4.9:1).

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: The shadow bevel of berry, and the error bubble's fill.

tokens.name: user-blue
tokens.usage: Not used for your bubbles any more: the user chose cream paper (see user-fill). Kept as the kitty blue (via user-blue-hi) and for future accents.

tokens.name: user-blue-hi
tokens.usage: Blue and cyan in the kitty console palette (readable on plum-900).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The Allow button fill and the 'Allowed' settle tag. Use outline-ink text on it (10.4:1). It is lighter than berry, so Allow and Deny differ in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: leaf-700
tokens.usage: The shadow bevel of leaf.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Alert and notification accents, and needs-you highlights. Use outline-ink text on it (10.2:1).

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: The shadow bevel of gold.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alias. The default fill for any Nell surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Alias. Hovered or raised surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alias. Inset wells, such as the text field.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Alias. Default text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Alias. Secondary text.

tokens.name: edge-light
tokens.usage: Alias. The 1-px top highlight that lets plum panels read on dark wallpapers.

tokens.name: edge-dark
tokens.usage: Alias. The 1-px bottom bevel.

tokens.name: user-fill
tokens.usage: Alias. Your own message bubbles are cream paper (user's choice), so it is clear who is speaking.

tokens.name: user-edge
tokens.usage: Alias. The top highlight edge of your bubbles.

tokens.name: user-ink
tokens.usage: Alias. Text on your bubbles (outline on cream).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Alias. The focus ring around the message bar (only the bar takes focus).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: 4× the font's 11px grid. Only for the cover and onboarding titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 1× grid, the native size. All bubble text, the bar, and buttons. It renders crisp at whole-number backing scales.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and chip labels, set in uppercase. The line height is tight so that buttons stay 2 grid rows tall.

styles.name: console
styles.usage: kitty inside the console frame only: 3x the 11px grid in points, so it is crisp on a 2x display (not at 1x). Set in kitty.conf, not in Nell's own views.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands and paths inside bubbles, set on a plum-900 inline chip.

spacing.note: Nell is drawn on a 2px art-pixel grid (her sprite at 2× zoom). Every gap is a whole number of art pixels.

tokens.name: px
tokens.usage: One art pixel: outline and bevel thickness, and the tail stair-step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, and the badge inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked bubbles, and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Bubble and bar inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the bubble column and Nell's head, and between the desk and the bar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The outer margin of the overlay from the screen edge.

tokens.name: bubble-max
tokens.usage: The maximum bubble width: 24 characters of body text plus padding. The column never grows wider.

radius.note: Pixel art has no curves. A 'radius' here is the size of the notched corner, drawn by leaving the corner pixel empty (see bundle.css .nl-frame). Never use CSS border-radius.

tokens.name: corner-none
tokens.usage: Inline code chips and the bar's inner well.

tokens.name: corner-1
tokens.usage: One missing art pixel at each corner. Used by every framed thing: bubbles, the bar, buttons, chips, badges.

shadow.note: Hard shadows only: no blur and no spread, offset in whole art pixels.

tokens.name: drop
tokens.usage: The 1-art-pixel ground shadow under bubbles and the bar.

tokens.name: drop-lg
tokens.usage: Approval and question bubbles, so that they sit visibly above the others.

tokens.name: bevel
tokens.usage: Raised plum panels: pink top edge, plum-800 bottom edge.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: A pressed button. The label also drops 1 art pixel.

opacity.note: The bubble-age ladder from the plan (BubbleStore.visible): at most 4 bubbles show, and the newest sits nearest Nell.

tokens.name: bubble-age-0
tokens.usage: The newest bubble.

tokens.name: bubble-age-1
tokens.usage: The second newest.

tokens.name: bubble-age-2
tokens.usage: The third newest.

tokens.name: bubble-age-3
tokens.usage: The oldest visible bubble. A fifth one is removed.
